responsibilities: Developed responsive web applications using modern front-end technologies.
Collaborated with designers and backend developers to improve UI/UX.
Implemented SEO best practices and optimized website performance.
Assisted in building websites using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Worked closely with senior developers to enhance functionality.
Tested and debugged web pages to ensure cross-browser compatibility.

personal_projects.name: Weather Dashboard
personal_projects.description: Developed a dynamic weather app where users can check real-time weather data for any city, powered by the OpenWeather API.

personal_projects.name: To-Do List App
personal_projects.description: Designed a to-do list application with React, allowing users to manage tasks with persistent data using local storage.

personal_projects.name: Movie Finder SPA
personal_projects.description: Implemented a single-page movie search app with JavaScript, allowing users to browse and discover movies interactively.

personal_projects.name: Italian Restaurant Website
personal_projects.description: Created a website for an Italian restaurant, focusing on layout and design that reflects the cuisine and ambiance.

personal_projects.name: Perfume Showcase Grid
personal_projects.description: Built a responsive product grid for perfume displays, using CSS grid for an elegant layout suitable for e-commerce.

personal_projects.name: Discover Ecuador
personal_projects.description: Created a web page highlighting the beauty of Ecuador, using responsive design for an engaging user experience.
